name: veneer
description: Turns Claude Code in the terminal into a desktop quality app with syntax highlighting on the side.

messageAlign.title: Message alignment
messageAlign.description: Where your own messages sit in the transcript.

styleUserMessage.title: Message styling
styleUserMessage.description: Draw your messages as a filled bubble. Turn off to leave them to Claude Code or another mod.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons in terminals that carry their own symbol font and Unicode symbols elsewhere. nerd always uses Nerd Font icons and needs a Nerd Font installed. plain always uses Unicode symbols.

links.title: File links
links.description: How a file path on a tool row is drawn. auto draws a link, and the full path as plain text in Rio and Terminal.app. link always draws a link, which Claude Code shows with its address beside it in a terminal it does not know to open links. text always draws the full path as plain text.

nativeTables.title: Text-based tables
nativeTables.description: Draw tables as a text card instead of a picture. Tables always use the card where pictures are unavailable.

nativeHeadings.title: Text-based headings
nativeHeadings.description: Draw headings as styled text instead of a picture. Headings always use text where pictures are unavailable.

nativeDiagrams.title: Text-based diagrams
nativeDiagrams.description: Draw Mermaid diagrams in box characters instead of a picture. Diagrams always use text where pictures are unavailable.

styleSpinner.title: Spinner styling
styleSpinner.description: Wrap the spinner line in Veneer's left margin. Turn off to leave it to Claude Code or another mod.

fontFamily.title: Table font
fontFamily.description: Font family for tables and headings. It must be installed on this machine.

cellRatio.title: Cell proportion
cellRatio.description: Height of a terminal cell over its width. Change it if pictures look tall, short or letterboxed.

fenceBackground.title: Code blocks
fenceBackground.description: Fill fenced code blocks with the syntax theme's background, when the theme sets one.

readBackground.title: File reads
readBackground.description: Fill the card of a file read with the syntax theme's background, when the theme sets one.

outputBackground.title: Command and search output
outputBackground.description: Fill highlighted Bash and Grep output with the syntax theme's background, when the theme sets one.

diffBackground.title: Diffs
diffBackground.description: Fill diff lines that have no added or removed fill with the syntax theme's background.
